dct_description_sm: This dataset contains the aqueous and solid phase geochemical data regarding the dissolution of arsenic trioxide roaster waste dust from underground chambers at the Giant Mine, Yellowknife, NT, Canada. Data include aqueous dissolution results, electron microprobe analysis values, X-ray absorption spectroscopy spectra and projects for As and Sb, powder X-ray diffraction and pair distribution function data, and transmission electron microscopy- selected area electron diffraction data as well as automated mineralogy.
